## Built-in help (secondary)

This section comes from `Commands_en.hlp` and may lag the implementation.

```text
ENABLE/AUTOFTX
```

**Enable Autogenerated FT4/8 spots**

## Details

If disabled, stop all automated FT4 or FT8 spots that conform to
patterns like:

```text
FT8 -17dB 1924Hz
FT4 +8 dB 1287 Hz
FT8 db-5
FT8 Sent: -23 Rcvd: -0
```

that appear be machine generated, but not things like:

```text
FT4   73!
<ES> FT8 -6 dB 1205 Hz CQ
IN80GN<>JO10NU FT8
```

that seem to be input by humans or contain more useful information
like locators.

Default is enabled (meaning you will get all FT4/8 spots).
